best_human.provenance: Published computational construction from the Shadoks CG:SHOP 2024 team. Their paper describes integer programming and heuristic search; the witness file metadata says it is from before digopt optimization.
best_human.ai_provenance: The source does not disclose use or non-use of AI tools.
best_human.evidence_state: published witness locally reproduced and exact geometry/value rechecked

best_public.source_location: Interactive instance results page, Shadoks card, value 2304/2304; also lists SmartPlacer 2268 and CGA Lab Salzburg 2105
best_public.provenance: Highest team solution shown on the checked public result page. This is a reported feasible value, not a proof of optimality.
best_public.evidence_state: public witness file recovered and independently validated

best_reproduced.provenance: The public Shadoks solution file was replayed and checked from its integer translations. No geometry values were rounded.
best_reproduced.evidence_state: exact triangulation, rational clipping, containment, and pairwise interior-disjointness checks

frozen_human_baseline.provenance: Replay of the published Shadoks computational witness; the code does not claim to reproduce their solver.

highest_reported.metric: sum of values of selected feasible items
highest_reported.source_location: Shadoks solution card and linked solution file
highest_reported.reproduction_status: reported and locally reproduced exactly; no optimality proof identified in the sources checked
